capabilities: Strip Markdown hyperlinks from a selection or the whole file
Strip wikilinks, keeping the text or alias per settings
Remove AI-style and Wikipedia-style citation links
Filter removal by internal versus external links
Whitelist or blacklist specific domains, URLs, and wikilink paths
extras: Also removes embedded images (e.g. ![[image.png]]) as part of link removal, not just text links; the README mentions donations via buy-me-a-coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-strip link syntax, which is tedious when cleaning up pasted web content or AI-generated text full of citation links.
summary: Command and context-menu tool that strips hyperlinks, wikilinks, and citation links from selected text or an entire note.
